title: God Will NEVER Fail You, There Is ALWAYS A Way (Christian Motivation)
paragraphs: I am going to encourage you and pray with you in the name of Jesus you are not here by accident or by simple chance but by Divine orchestration today I am here to tell you that God's promises never fail there is always a way we are living in challenging times the world around us can feel chaotic filled with uncertainties problems and obstacles that seem insurmountable sometimes we look to our left we look to our right and we see no way forward

it might seem as if the darkness is all consuming the night too long and the tunnel too endless but I am here to remind you today remind you of a god whose promises never fail and who in his infinite wisdom and power always makes a way take a moment to Journey back in time with me to the life of a man named Abraham Abraham previously called Abram was an ordinary man with an ordinary life living in a city called Ur he

was comfortable he had a wife a family and he probably had dreams and hopes like any of us listening today but then one day God Called to him in Genesis 12 verse 1 he said go from your country your people and your father's household to the land I will show you and what did God promise this ordinary man he continued in Genesis 12 verses 2 to 3 which says I will make you into a great nation and I will bless you

I will make your name great and you will be a blessing I will bless those who bless you and whoever curses you I will curse and all peoples on Earth will be blessed through you what a huge promise don't you think imagine how big this promise was to a man who had no child of his own time passed unto Braum later called Abraham saw no fulfillment of This Promise his situation seemed impossible he was old his wife Sarah was past child-bearing

age but God had made a promise Sarah laughed when she heard it she laughed because it seemed too good to be true it sounded impossible yet we know the story despite their Advanced ages despite the impossibility Isaac was born why because when God makes a promise it never fails there is always a way our God is a covenant keeping God his words are not mere words but vows that carry power his words bring into existence what did not exist before when

God promised to give the Israelites the land of Canaan a land flowing with milk and honey it seemed impossible they were slaves in Egypt persecuted and oppressed but God through the hand of Moses LED them out of bondage yes there were obstacles there was the Red Sea there were hostile Nations there were giants in the land but every single time God Made A Way when they stood before the Red Sea trapped with the Egyptian Army advancing towards them it looked like

the end but what happened God made a way where there was no way he parted the Red Sea and they walked on dry ground when they were hungry and thirsty in the wilderness God rained down Manna From Heaven and brought water from a rock when they faced fortified cities and giant Warriors God fought for them Jericho's walls came tumbling down not by their might not by their power but by the power and spirit of God his promises were not just to

Abraham or the Israelites but they extend to you and me today consider the words of Jesus himself in Matthew 11 verses 28 to 30. come to me all you who are weary and burdened and I will give you rest take my yoke upon you and learn from me for I am gentle and humble in heart and you will find rest for your souls for my yoke is easy and my burden is light here is a promise from God to you today

are you tired weary burdened Jesus is saying come he promises to give you rest to lighten your burden you may be looking at your situation your problems your struggles and they may seem too big too difficult too impossible but remember Abraham remember the Israelites remember God's faithfulness when you find yourself in the Valley of the shadow of death when you feel surrounded by your enemies remember God's promise in Psalm 23 he is your shepherd He will lead you beside Still Waters

he will restore your soul even though you walk through the valley you do not need to fear for he is with you he prepares a table before you in the presence of your enemies surely goodness and mercy will follow you all the days of your life God's promises are steadfast they are undisputable unchanging and they are immovable they never fail when God speaks when he promises he does not speak lightly he does not change his mind he does not forget he

does not fail numbers 23 verse 19 tells us God is Not Human that he should lie not a human being that he should change his mind does he speak and then not act does he promise and not fulfill in your darkest hour in your deepest despair in your most stressful moment hold on to the promises of God trust in his faithfulness believe in his unfailing love stand on his word remember the cross of Calvary the ultimate demonstration of God's unfailing promise

Jesus Christ Our Savior bore our sins carried our infirmities and through his resurrection granted us victory over death the trials of this life may seem overwhelming the night may seem long the valley may seem deep the mountain may seem insurmountable but hold on to this truth God's promises never fail there is always a way his way his truth his life stand on This Promise today for he is the same yesterday today and forevermore may God's unfailing promises be your anchor in

times of storm your guide in moments of uncertain certainty your comfort in times of sorrow and your hope in times of Despair God's promises never fail there is always a way always now let us go to the Lord in prayer I want you to pray this prayer with me so that you can have all the blessings of this prayer let us pray to our gracious God dear heavenly father the Alpha and the Omega the beginning and the end the one who

holds the universe in the palm of your hand I come before you today humbly and sincerely recognizing your sovereignty Lord I bring myself before you in all my Frailty and Imperfections I recognize my own shortcomings my weaknesses and my mistakes I ask for your forgiveness may you cleanse me from all unrighteousness may you wash me whiter than snow make me clean Lord Make Me pure father I pray for your guidance lead me in the way of righteousness show me your path

make straight my steps and direct my decisions Lord I desire to walk in your way to follow your direction help me to discern your will in every circumstance God I pray for your wisdom Enlighten my mind and heart with your truth help me to see clearly to understand deeply to discern wisely grant me the wisdom to know what is right and to have the courage to do it Lord I pray for your strength life can be hard the journey can be

tough the battles can be fierce I can't do it on my own Lord I need your strength I need your power and your might if for every challenge gerd me for every battle and strengthen me for every task oh Father God I pray for your provision you are the Lord who provides Lord may you meet my needs according to your riches in glory Lord I ask you to provide for my physical needs my emotional needs and spiritual needs Lord let your

peace and love overflow in my life I thank you Lord that you are the Prince of Peace who still the storms within My Heart Lord take away all waves of anxiety and fear from my life let your peace that surpasses all understanding guard my heart and my mind in Christ Jesus Lord let me be a vessel of your love and your grace father I pray for your Holy Spirit to fill me let your holy spirit guide me Empower me and transform

me let the fruits of your spirit be evident in my life love joy peace patience kindness goodness faithfulness gentleness and self-control precious Lord I pray for an unshakable Faith a faith that trusts you in every situation a faith that believes you for the impossible of faith that stands firm in the face of adversity help my unbelief dear Lord I Thank you for increasing my faith father I believe in your promises I believe that you make all the good difference in my

life and that you will always make a way for me even when there seem to be no way in the mighty name of Jesus I pray amen now claim this powerful prayer by typing the word amen in the comments section below may the Lord bless you abundantly and powerfully I declare that all the blessings of this prayer are now upon you in the name of Jesus you can help us to reach more persons and spread the gospel you can do this

by sharing the video and clicking the like button also if this message has been a blessing to you subscribe to the channel for more videos we appreciate all your support May the grace and peace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all
